name: Logistic Regression — Baseline
description: First-pass baseline. Per-fighter rolling statistics computed from prior UFC fights only — striking volume/accuracy/defense, takedowns, control time, knockdowns, sub attempts, physical (height/reach/age), recency. Logistic regression on A−B differentials. **No opponent-quality signal (no Elo).** Useful as a reference point to see what adding features buys.

name: Elo + Gradient Boosting
description: v1's rolling-stat features plus a per-fighter Elo rating (K=24, start 1500) computed forward-only. Captures opponent quality — beating a top-10 fighter feeds Elo more than beating a debutant. Trains both LogisticRegression and HistGradientBoostingClassifier and uses whichever achieves lower test log-loss.

name: Advanced — Elo + recency + style + durability
description: v2's Elo plus skill-decay during long layoffs and a variable K-factor (title K=36, main event K=30, rust K=14, KO/sub-finish margin bonus). Adds last-5 form features separate from career averages, stance matchup one-hots, and durability proxies (chin = KDs absorbed/fight, cardio = rounds reached, defensive grappling = sub attempts defended). Best of LR vs gradient-boosted by test log-loss.

name: Stacker — LR over v1/v2/v3
description: Logistic regression meta-classifier trained on v1, v2, and v3's raw model_p outputs (plus mean/std/max/min across them and the opener implied probability). Discovered in Tier-3 research as the dominant single improvement: drops 2025+ test log-loss from 0.6904 (best base model) to 0.6253 and lifts edge>=0.10 dog-bet ROI from +10% to +19% on a smaller, sharper pick set.

name: Accuracy v5 — XGBoost + Adjusted Performance
description: XGBoost classifier on a 44-feature set combining Vegas closer/opener, fighter career and recent-form stats, physical attributes, and opponent-adjusted performance metrics (lpm/apm/str_def/td_per15/kd/ctrl_per_min normalized vs what each opponent typically allows, weight-class shrunk). Trained 2014-2023, calibrated on 2024, tested on 2025+. Test accuracy 70.11% on 736 fights — matches mma-ai.net's reported 70.08% on a 3x larger sample, making it the most credibly verified public UFC model.

name: v6 — Value (ROI)
description: The ROI model. Trained with the opening line as an input, so it learns where the market's opener is systematically wrong instead of re-deriving the market. Picks are locked at first write and never re-priced. Walk-forward 2021–2026 (six years the model never saw): the shipped rule (favorites with 3+ points of edge, $100 flat) went 129-55 (70.1%), P&L +$2,498 on $18,400 staked, ROI +13.6%, profitable 5 of 6 years. Simulated point-in-time record — the live record starts July 2026.
